## Standalone inputs

```{r load-standalone-inputs}
# ============================================================
# Standalone input loading
# 02 is the sole source of population / age denominators.
# 06 is the sole source of municipality-month posterior IRRs.
# ============================================================

inla_results_dir <- RESULTS_DIR

irr_path <- file.path(
  inla_results_dir,
  "st_rate_chik_region_2016_2025.rds"
)

# Revised Step-02 files are saved in the centrally configured results directory.
pop_total_path <- result_path("pop_panel_total.rds")
pop_age_path   <- result_path("pop_panel_age.rds")

required_files <- c(
  irr_path,
  pop_total_path,
  pop_age_path
)

missing_files <- required_files[!file.exists(required_files)]

if (length(missing_files) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing required Step-07 input file(s):\n",
    paste(missing_files, collapse = "\n")
  )
}

st_rate_chik_region <- readRDS(irr_path)
pop_panel_total     <- readRDS(pop_total_path)
pop_panel_age       <- readRDS(pop_age_path)

# Standardize municipality codes defensively.
st_rate_chik_region <- st_rate_chik_region %>%
  mutate(code_muni = stringr::str_pad(as.character(code_muni), 6, pad = "0"))

pop_panel_total <- pop_panel_total %>%
  mutate(code_muni = stringr::str_pad(as.character(code_muni), 6, pad = "0"))

pop_panel_age <- pop_panel_age %>%
  mutate(code_muni = stringr::str_pad(as.character(code_muni), 6, pad = "0"))

cat("\n=== STANDALONE INPUT CHECK ===\n")
cat("IRR rows:", nrow(st_rate_chik_region), "\n")
cat("IRR municipalities:", dplyr::n_distinct(st_rate_chik_region$code_muni), "\n")
cat("Population municipality-years:", nrow(pop_panel_total), "\n")
cat("Age-panel municipality-years:",
    dplyr::n_distinct(paste(pop_panel_age$code_muni, pop_panel_age$year)), "\n")

stopifnot(
  nrow(st_rate_chik_region) == 668400L,
  dplyr::n_distinct(st_rate_chik_region$code_muni) == 5570L,
  sum(is.na(st_rate_chik_region$IRR)) == 0L,
  nrow(pop_panel_total) == 55700L,
  dplyr::n_distinct(pop_panel_total$code_muni) == 5570L,
  dplyr::n_distinct(pop_panel_age$code_muni) == 5570L
)

cat("PASS: standalone Step-07 inputs loaded successfully.\n")
```


> **2026 revision note.** The upstream INLA model now covers all 5,570
> Brazilian municipalities for 2016–2025, including municipality-months
> with zero reported cases. This script therefore treats 5,570 as a hard
> coverage requirement. Any join that reduces the priority framework below
> 5,570 stops execution instead of silently dropping municipalities.
>
> **This file is the current bivariate-tertile version of the priority
> map (Steps 9-13).** Per the plan, this whole approach is being
> replaced/rehabilitated: the tertile scheme itself is not defensible as
> the final claim (S9 caption shows it collapses to an age-only rule at
> matched coverage), and the target is a continuous expected-burden
> metric (Step 11, Metric A = 18-59 eligible / Metric B = 60+ excluded)
> with the zone map demoted to a communication layer derived *from* that
> metric (Step 13). None of that rebuild is in this file yet -- this is
> the pre-revision version, kept intact so the rebuild has a clear
> starting point and the Supp9 capture-curve logic (which the rebuild
> reuses) is preserved.

## Age structure from IBGE table 9514 (65+ share by municipality)

```{r age-structure-from-pop-panel}
# Uses pop_panel_age
# (from 02_population_panel.R), computing prop_65plus per municipality
# as the average over each window's own years, matching how
# pop_export_recent/pop_export_cum already handle total population.
# Step 02 is the sole source of population and age denominators.
# Here we only derive the annual 65+ proportion needed by Figure 2.
age65_by_year <- pop_panel_age %>%
  filter(age >= 65) %>%
  group_by(code_muni, year) %>%
  summarise(pop_65plus = sum(pop, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(
    pop_panel_total %>% select(code_muni, year, total_pop),
    by = c("code_muni", "year")
  ) %>%
  mutate(prop_65plus = pop_65plus / total_pop)

stopifnot(
  nrow(age65_by_year) == 5570L * 10L,
  !anyDuplicated(age65_by_year[c("code_muni", "year")]),
  sum(is.na(age65_by_year$prop_65plus)) == 0
)

# Window summaries of the annual Step-02 values; these are not a
# separate age-structure dataset.
summarise_age_window <- function(years) {
  age65_by_year %>%
    filter(year %in% years) %>%
    group_by(code_muni) %>%
    summarise(
      prop_65plus = mean(prop_65plus, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

age_struct_recent <- summarise_age_window(2024:2025)
age_struct_cum    <- summarise_age_window(2016:2025)

cat("age_struct_recent municipalities:", nrow(age_struct_recent), "\n")
cat("age_struct_cum municipalities:", nrow(age_struct_cum), "\n")

```

## Build municipality-level IRR + age structure + region

```{r build-mun-data}
# Population is the window-matched average from pop_panel_total: each
# window (2024-25 vs 2016-25) gets its own average population over the
# years it actually covers.
make_pop_export <- function(years) {
  pop_panel_total %>%
    filter(year %in% years) %>%
    group_by(code_muni) %>%
    summarise(total_pop = mean(total_pop, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
}

pop_export_recent <- make_pop_export(2024:2025)
pop_export_cum    <- make_pop_export(2016:2025)

irr_2024_25 <- st_rate_chik_region %>%
  filter(year(ym_date) %in% c(2024, 2025)) %>%
  group_by(code_muni) %>%
  summarise(mean_irr_2024_25 = mean(IRR, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

irr_2016_25 <- st_rate_chik_region %>%
  filter(year(ym_date) %in% 2016:2025) %>%
  group_by(code_muni) %>%
  summarise(mean_irr_2016_25 = mean(IRR, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

posterior_irr <- irr_2024_25 %>% left_join(irr_2016_25, by = "code_muni")

nrow(posterior_irr)
summary(posterior_irr$mean_irr_2024_25)

state_region_fig2 <- tibble(
  code_state = sprintf("%02d", c(11,12,13,14,15,16,17,
                                  21,22,23,24,25,26,27,28,29,
                                  31,32,33,35,
                                  41,42,43,
                                  50,51,52,53)),
  name_region = c(rep("North", 7), rep("Northeast", 9), rep("Southeast", 4),
                  rep("South", 3), rep("Central-West", 4))
)

build_mun_data <- function(irr_col, window_label, pop_export, age_struct_window) {
  posterior_irr %>%
    select(code_muni, irr = all_of(irr_col)) %>%
    left_join(age_struct_window %>% select(code_muni, prop_65plus), by = "code_muni") %>%
    left_join(pop_export, by = "code_muni") %>%
    mutate(window = window_label, code_state = substr(code_muni, 1, 2)) %>%
    left_join(state_region_fig2, by = "code_state") %>%
    filter(!is.na(irr), !is.na(prop_65plus))
}

mun_data_recent <- build_mun_data("mean_irr_2024_25", "2024_2025", pop_export_recent, age_struct_recent)
mun_data_cum    <- build_mun_data("mean_irr_2016_25", "2016_2025", pop_export_cum, age_struct_cum)

cat("\n=== Municipality coverage check ===\n")
cat("Posterior municipalities (2024-25):", nrow(irr_2024_25), "\n")
cat("Posterior municipalities (2016-25):", nrow(irr_2016_25), "\n")
cat("Age-structure municipalities (2024-25):", nrow(age_struct_recent), "\n")
cat("Population municipalities (2024-25):", nrow(pop_export_recent), "\n")
cat("Final priority-framework municipalities:", nrow(mun_data_recent), "\n")

# Step 4 revision:
# The revised 06 model uses the complete 5,570-municipality panel,
# including municipalities with zero reported cases. The priority
# framework must therefore also retain all 5,570 municipalities.
expected_n_muni <- 5570L

if (nrow(mun_data_recent) != expected_n_muni) {
  missing_from_priority <- tibble(
    code_muni = unique(st_rate_chik_region$code_muni)
  ) %>%
    anti_join(mun_data_recent %>% select(code_muni), by = "code_muni")

  print(missing_from_priority)

  stop(
    "Priority framework contains ", nrow(mun_data_recent),
    " municipalities, not 5,570. Do not continue: inspect IRR, ",
    "population, and age-structure joins above."
  )
}

stopifnot(
  n_distinct(irr_2024_25$code_muni) == expected_n_muni,
  n_distinct(irr_2016_25$code_muni) == expected_n_muni,
  n_distinct(age_struct_recent$code_muni) == expected_n_muni,
  n_distinct(age_struct_cum$code_muni) == expected_n_muni,
  n_distinct(pop_export_recent$code_muni) == expected_n_muni,
  n_distinct(pop_export_cum$code_muni) == expected_n_muni,
  n_distinct(mun_data_recent$code_muni) == expected_n_muni,
  n_distinct(mun_data_cum$code_muni) == expected_n_muni
)
cat("PASS: all 5,570 Brazilian municipalities retained in both revised priority windows.\n")
```

## Tertile binning and Figure 2 panels

```{r tertile-binning}
bin_tertiles <- function(d) {
  d %>% mutate(inc_bin = ntile(irr, 3), age_bin = ntile(prop_65plus, 3),
               bi_class = paste(inc_bin, age_bin, sep = "-"))
}

mun_data_recent <- bin_tertiles(mun_data_recent)
mun_data_cum    <- bin_tertiles(mun_data_cum)

tertile_cuts <- mun_data_recent %>%
  summarise(irr_t1 = quantile(irr, 1/3, na.rm = TRUE), irr_t2 = quantile(irr, 2/3, na.rm = TRUE),
            age_t1 = quantile(prop_65plus, 1/3, na.rm = TRUE), age_t2 = quantile(prop_65plus, 2/3, na.rm = TRUE))
print(tertile_cuts)

# Tertile thresholds and zone counts are recalculated from the full
# 5,570-municipality revised framework. Do not reuse the old 3,879-based
# thresholds or municipality counts in the manuscript.

three_tone_pal <- c(
  "1-1" = "#EDEAE0", "2-1" = "#B5D4F4", "3-1" = "#185FA5",
  "1-2" = "#E5BBAE", "2-2" = "#A89BB8", "3-2" = "#5C5598",
  "1-3" = "#A32D2D", "2-3" = "#7C3D6C", "3-3" = "#3C3489"
)
corner_blue   <- "#185FA5"
corner_red    <- "#A32D2D"
corner_purple <- "#3C3489"

dir.create(RESULTS_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

if (!file.exists(result_path("mun_sf_simplified.rds"))) {
  mun_sf_fig <- read_municipality(year = 2020, simplified = TRUE, showProgress = FALSE) %>%
    st_transform(4326) %>%
    mutate(code_muni = str_pad(substr(as.character(code_muni), 1, 6), 6, pad = "0"))
  saveRDS(mun_sf_fig, result_path("mun_sf_simplified.rds"))
} else {
  mun_sf_fig <- readRDS(result_path("mun_sf_simplified.rds"))
}

build_panel_a <- function(mun_data, mun_sf, subtitle = "A  Bivariate priority map") {
  map_data <- mun_sf %>%
    mutate(code_muni = str_pad(substr(as.character(code_muni), 1, 6), 6, pad = "0")) %>%
    left_join(mun_data %>% select(code_muni, bi_class), by = "code_muni")
  ggplot(map_data) +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = bi_class), color = "grey20", linewidth = 0.01) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = three_tone_pal, na.value = "white", guide = "none") +
    labs(subtitle = subtitle) +
    theme_void(base_size = 10) +
    theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(face = "bold", margin = margin(b = 4)),
          plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
          panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA))
}

build_legend <- function() {
  legend_grid <- expand_grid(inc_bin = 1:3, age_bin = 1:3) %>%
    mutate(bi_class = paste(inc_bin, age_bin, sep = "-"))
  ggplot(legend_grid, aes(x = inc_bin, y = age_bin, fill = bi_class)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.6) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = three_tone_pal, guide = "none") +
    coord_fixed(clip = "off") +
    annotate("text", x = 3.6, y = 1, label = "Transmission\ncontrol", color = corner_blue,
             hjust = 0, size = 2.7, fontface = "bold", lineheight = 0.9) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.4, y = 3, label = "Clinical\npreparedness", color = corner_red,
             hjust = 1, size = 2.7, fontface = "bold", lineheight = 0.9) +
    annotate("text", x = 3.6, y = 3, label = "Both", color = corner_purple, hjust = 0, size = 2.7, fontface = "bold") +
    labs(x = "Recent IRR ->", y = "% pop >=65 ->") +
    theme_void(base_size = 8) +
    theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size = 8, margin = margin(t = 4)),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 8, angle = 90, margin = margin(r = 4)),
          plot.margin = margin(4, 40, 4, 40))
}

region_pal <- c("North" = "#1D9E75", "Northeast" = "#D85A30", "Central-West" = "#EF9F27",
                "Southeast" = "#7F77DD", "South" = "#378ADD")

build_panel_b <- function(mun_data, subtitle = "B  Municipality-level targeting space") {
  cuts <- mun_data %>%
    summarise(irr_t2 = quantile(irr, 2/3, na.rm = TRUE), age_t2 = quantile(prop_65plus, 2/3, na.rm = TRUE))
  ggplot(mun_data, aes(x = irr, y = prop_65plus * 100)) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = cuts$irr_t2, xmax = Inf, ymin = -Inf, ymax = cuts$age_t2 * 100,
             fill = corner_blue, alpha = 0.06) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = cuts$irr_t2, ymin = cuts$age_t2 * 100, ymax = Inf,
             fill = corner_red, alpha = 0.06) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = cuts$irr_t2, xmax = Inf, ymin = cuts$age_t2 * 100, ymax = Inf,
             fill = corner_purple, alpha = 0.10) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = cuts$irr_t2, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey55", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = cuts$age_t2 * 100, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey55", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_point(aes(color = name_region), alpha = 0.5, size = 0.6) +
    scale_x_log10(name = "Recent IRR (log scale)") +
    scale_y_continuous(name = "% population >=65 years", labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")) +
    scale_color_manual(values = region_pal, name = "Macro-region", breaks = names(region_pal)) +
    labs(subtitle = subtitle) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(face = "bold", margin = margin(b = 4)),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom", legend.key.size = unit(8, "pt")) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 2)))
}

panel_a <- build_panel_a(mun_data_recent, mun_sf_fig)
legend  <- build_legend()
panel_b <- build_panel_b(mun_data_recent)

fig2_recent <- (panel_a / legend + plot_layout(heights = c(3, 1))) | panel_b
print(fig2_recent)

panel_a_cum <- build_panel_a(mun_data_cum, mun_sf_fig)
panel_b_cum <- build_panel_b(mun_data_cum)
fig2_cum <- (panel_a_cum / legend + plot_layout(heights = c(3, 1))) | panel_b_cum
print(fig2_cum)

print(tertile_cuts)

policy_by_region <- mun_data_recent %>%
  group_by(name_region) %>%
  summarise(n_total = n(),
            n_transmission = sum(inc_bin == 3 & age_bin < 3),
            n_preparedness = sum(inc_bin < 3 & age_bin == 3),
            n_both = sum(inc_bin == 3 & age_bin == 3), .groups = "drop")
print(policy_by_region)

zone_counts <- mun_data_recent %>%
  summarise(
    n_total = n(),
    n_transmission = sum(inc_bin == 3 & age_bin < 3),
    n_preparedness = sum(inc_bin < 3 & age_bin == 3),
    n_both = sum(inc_bin == 3 & age_bin == 3),
    n_intermediate = sum(!(inc_bin == 3 & age_bin < 3) &
                         !(inc_bin < 3 & age_bin == 3) &
                         !(inc_bin == 3 & age_bin == 3))
  )

print(zone_counts)

cat("\n=== Revised Figure 6 quantities ===\n")
cat("Municipalities:", nrow(mun_data_recent), "\n")
cat("IRR tertile cut-points:",
    round(tertile_cuts$irr_t1, 4), "and",
    round(tertile_cuts$irr_t2, 4), "\n")
cat("Age 65+ tertile cut-points:",
    round(100 * tertile_cuts$age_t1, 2), "% and",
    round(100 * tertile_cuts$age_t2, 2), "%\n")
print(zone_counts)
```

## Case fatality rate by macro-region and epidemic window

```{r cfr-by-macroregion}
cfr_region <- Chik_total %>%
  mutate(year = as.integer(format(as.Date(DT_SIN_PRI), "%Y")),
         code_state = substr(as.character(ID_MUNICIP), 1, 2),
         HOSPITALIZ = as.character(HOSPITALIZ)) %>%
  filter(CLASSI_FIN %in% c(1, 13), HOSPITALIZ == "1") %>%
  left_join(state_region_lookup, by = "code_state") %>%   # from 06_inla_spacetime_model.Rmd
  filter(!is.na(region)) %>%
  mutate(epidemic = case_when(
    year %in% 2016:2017 ~ "Epidemic 1 (2016-2017)",
    year %in% 2024:2025 ~ "Epidemic 2 (2024-2025)",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )) %>%
  filter(!is.na(epidemic)) %>%
  group_by(region, epidemic) %>%
  summarise(hosp_confirmed = n(), deaths = sum(EVOLUCAO == 2, na.rm = TRUE),
            CFR_pct = round(deaths / hosp_confirmed * 100, 2), .groups = "drop")

print(cfr_region)

# NOTE (Step 10): Table S5 currently compares these two windows with no
# formal statistic -- Step 10 replaces this with a shared component
# model (Knorr-Held/Best) quantifying spatial concordance with a
# credible interval across the whole 2016-2025 period, not just an
# eyeball comparison of two epidemic windows.
```

## Supp9 follow-up: cumulative-capture curves (Metric A vs age-only vs framework zones)

This is the block underlying the S9 caption finding that motivated the
whole revision: at matched coverage, the clinical-preparedness/combined
zones select the same municipalities as an age-only rule.

```{r supp9-muni-df}
cases_2425_muni <- Chik_total %>%
  mutate(year = as.integer(format(as.Date(DT_SIN_PRI), "%Y")),
         code_muni = str_pad(substr(as.character(ID_MUNICIP), 1, 6), 6, pad = "0")) %>%
  filter(CLASSI_FIN %in% c(1, 13), year %in% c(2024, 2025)) %>%
  count(code_muni, name = "cases_2425")

deaths_65plus_muni <- Chik_total %>%
  mutate(year = as.integer(format(as.Date(DT_SIN_PRI), "%Y")),
         code_muni = str_pad(substr(as.character(ID_MUNICIP), 1, 6), 6, pad = "0"),
         age_years = decode_age_years(NU_IDADE_N)) %>%    # from 01_data_import_cleaning.Rmd
  filter(EVOLUCAO == 2, year %in% c(2024, 2025), !is.na(age_years), age_years >= 65) %>%
  count(code_muni, name = "deaths_65plus")

muni_df <- mun_data_recent %>%
  transmute(
    code_muni,
    irr_2425 = irr,
    prop_65 = prop_65plus,
    pop_total = total_pop,
    pop_65plus = prop_65plus * total_pop,
    zone = case_when(
      inc_bin == 3 & age_bin < 3 ~ "transmission-control",
      inc_bin < 3 & age_bin == 3 ~ "clinical-preparedness",
      inc_bin == 3 & age_bin == 3 ~ "combined",
      TRUE ~ "neither"
    )
  ) %>%
  left_join(cases_2425_muni, by = "code_muni") %>%
  left_join(deaths_65plus_muni, by = "code_muni") %>%
  mutate(
    cases_2425 = replace_na(cases_2425, 0),
    deaths_65plus = replace_na(deaths_65plus, 0)
  )

stopifnot(
  nrow(muni_df) == 5570L,
  n_distinct(muni_df$code_muni) == 5570L,
  sum(is.na(muni_df$pop_65plus)) == 0L
)

cat("PASS: Supp9 municipality dataset contains all 5,570 municipalities.\n")

cat("\n=== Supp9 municipality coverage ===\n")
cat("Rows:", nrow(muni_df), "\n")
cat("Unique municipalities:", n_distinct(muni_df$code_muni), "\n")
print(colSums(is.na(muni_df)))

stopifnot(
  nrow(muni_df) == expected_n_muni,
  n_distinct(muni_df$code_muni) == expected_n_muni,
  sum(is.na(muni_df$pop_65plus)) == 0,
  sum(is.na(muni_df$pop_total)) == 0
)

cat("PASS: Supp9 also retains all 5,570 municipalities.\n")
```

```{r supp9-capture-share}
total_2425 <- sum(muni_df$cases_2425)

cases_left <- muni_df %>%
  filter(prop_65 < quantile(prop_65, 2/3)) %>%
  summarise(pct_cases_left = 100 * sum(cases_2425) / total_2425)

cat("\n=== Cases left unprioritised by age-only ===\n")
cat(sprintf("Cases in municipalities age-only would not prioritise: %.1f%%\n", cases_left$pct_cases_left))

muni_df <- muni_df %>% mutate(age_only_selected = prop_65 >= quantile(prop_65, 2/3))

muni_df <- muni_df %>% mutate(hi_sev_py = pop_65plus)
total <- sum(muni_df$hi_sev_py)
zone_capture_pop <- muni_df %>% filter(zone %in% c("clinical-preparedness", "combined")) %>%
  summarise(pct = 100 * sum(hi_sev_py) / total)
age_only_capture_pop <- muni_df %>% filter(age_only_selected) %>%
  summarise(pct = 100 * sum(hi_sev_py) / total)

muni_df <- muni_df %>% mutate(hi_sev_py = deaths_65plus)
total <- sum(muni_df$hi_sev_py)
zone_capture_death <- muni_df %>% filter(zone %in% c("clinical-preparedness", "combined")) %>%
  summarise(pct = 100 * sum(hi_sev_py) / total)
age_only_capture_death <- muni_df %>% filter(age_only_selected) %>%
  summarise(pct = 100 * sum(hi_sev_py) / total)

cat("\n=== Severity capture at equal coverage ===\n")
cat(sprintf("n age-only selected (upper tertile): %d\n", sum(muni_df$age_only_selected)))
cat("\n-- Weight A: 65+ population --\n")
cat(sprintf("framework (prep+combined): %.1f%%\n", zone_capture_pop$pct))
cat(sprintf("age-only (upper tertile):  %.1f%%\n", age_only_capture_pop$pct))
cat("\n-- Weight B: observed 65+ deaths (2024-25) --\n")
cat(sprintf("framework (prep+combined): %.1f%%\n", zone_capture_death$pct))
cat(sprintf("age-only (upper tertile):  %.1f%%\n", age_only_capture_death$pct))

muni_df <- muni_df %>% select(-hi_sev_py, -age_only_selected)

# THIS is the S9 finding in numbers: if zone_capture and age_only_capture
# are close, the severity axis is adding little beyond an age-only rule
# -- the exact problem Step 11's Metric A/B rebuild is meant to fix.
```

```{r supp9-cumulative-curves}
make_curve <- function(df, order_var, label) {
  df %>%
    arrange(desc(.data[[order_var]])) %>%
    transmute(strategy = label, n_muni = row_number(), cov_frac = n_muni / n(),
              cum_cases = cumsum(cases_2425) / sum(cases_2425),
              cum_sev = cumsum(pop_65plus) / sum(pop_65plus))
}

curves <- bind_rows(
  make_curve(muni_df, "irr_2425", "Prioritise by transmission (2024-25 IRR)"),
  make_curve(muni_df, "prop_65",  "Age-only (% aged 65+)")
)

k <- round(nrow(muni_df) / 3)
headline <- curves %>% filter(n_muni == k)

age_cases  <- headline$cum_cases[grepl("Age-only", headline$strategy)]
rule_cases <- headline$cum_cases[grepl("transmission", headline$strategy)]

cat("\n=== Capture at matched coverage (k =", k, ") ===\n")
cat(sprintf("Transmission ranking captures: %.0f%% of 2024-25 cases\n", 100 * rule_cases))
cat(sprintf("Age-only ranking captures:     %.0f%% of 2024-25 cases\n", 100 * age_cases))
cat(sprintf("Age-only leaves unprioritised: %.0f%% of 2024-25 cases\n", 100 * (1 - age_cases)))

plot_df <- curves %>%
  pivot_longer(c(cum_cases, cum_sev), names_to = "axis", values_to = "captured") %>%
  mutate(axis = recode(axis, cum_cases = "A  2024-25 cases captured", cum_sev = "B  Population aged 65+ captured"))

ggplot(plot_df, aes(cov_frac, captured, colour = strategy)) +
  geom_abline(
    slope = 1,
    intercept = 0,
    linetype = 3,
    colour = "grey70"
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 1/3,
    linetype = 2,
    colour = "grey60"
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~axis) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = percent,
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = percent,
    limits = c(0, 1),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      `Prioritise by transmission (2024-25 IRR)` = "#2c7fb8",
      `Age-only (% aged 65+)` = "#d95f0e"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Municipalities prioritised (cumulative %, ranked by each strategy)",
    y = "Cumulative share captured",
    colour = NULL,
    caption = paste0(
      "Dashed vertical line = matched coverage (upper tertile, n = ",
      k,
      "). Dotted diagonal = line of equality."
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing = unit(1.2, "lines"),
    strip.text = element_text(
      hjust = 0,
      face = "bold"
    )
  )
```

## Next: Step 11 rebuild (not yet in this file)

The above reproduces the current (pre-revision) tertile framework and
its Supp9 diagnostic. The Step 11 rebuild -- expected-burden Metric A
(18-59, currently deployable IXCHIQ) and Metric B (60+, the case for the
CHIKV VLP product under ANVISA review), propagated posterior uncertainty,
and the four-rule comparison figure (transmission-only / age-only /
expected-burden / random) -- is new work to add here, not a
reorganization of existing code.
